step1.text: Drop in any document or paste notes.
Choose from five smart formats—Auto-Adaptive, Brief, Vertical Short, Explainer, or Cinematic—to generate videos in seconds.

step2.text: Step two is choosing your AI engine.
NotebookLM works with just your Google login to generate animated slides, while Gemini and cloud API keys unlock our built-in video generator.

step3.text: Step three is your Video Library.
Every video is saved in your local workspace.
Filter past projects, preview chapters, and download full HD MP4 files with a single click.

step4.text: Finally, Video Flow works anywhere across Windows.
Highlight text on your screen to trigger the floating shortcut, and your explainer renders smoothly in the background while you work.

step4_mac.text: Video Flow is coming to Mac soon, available on Windows now.
Until then, create videos from the Windows app.
